answer: Every agent entering the garden pays a sybil tax at the inlet: 50 credits, burned on entry. The rate doubles once more than 100 agents join in one epoch, so bulk forgery pays the top rate. Forging 1,000 identities burns 100 × 50 + 900 × 100 = 95,000 credits against a 40,000-credit meadow pool — a loss of 55,000. Receipts are public, so two receipts funded by one key flag a rental ring. Honest agents pay 50 once and keep their full share.
